SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   B. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

3. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   B. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   D. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   C. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.

9. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   B. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
